description: baseline 100-button render benchmark before renderer changes

asi.hypothesis: establish baseline for 100-button MiniJinja Flex render path

description: skip Flex child clones when no overflow indicator exists

asi.hypothesis: Avoid cloning Flex children for the common no-OnOverflow path so layout builds less temporary tree data.

description: measure visible text width without allocating plain strings

asi.hypothesis: Compute visible width in one pass and skip ANSI escapes without allocating a temporary plain String.

description: use empty default cells and synthesize spaces only in final frame

asi.hypothesis: Avoid allocating and cloning a one-character String for untouched blank cells.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 568us to 627us despite better p50.
asi.next_action_hint: Look for width or layout scans that reduce p95 without changing cell blank representation.

description: avoid Vec allocation for one-line natural text size

asi.hypothesis: Fast-path single-line text sizing to avoid collecting split lines for labels and row text.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 568us to 639us.
asi.next_action_hint: Single-line contains scans add more cost than the avoided Vec allocation on this path.

description: blit clipped flex children without an intermediate canvas

asi.hypothesis: Avoid allocating a cropped Canvas for every visible Flex child by copying from a source offset during blit.
asi.note: Also removed the now-unused crop helper and updated the clipping test to exercise blit_from.

description: fast-path plain ASCII text painting

asi.hypothesis: Plain printable ASCII text has one cell per byte, so text_canvas can skip ANSI and unicode-width state machines for that common case.
asi.tradeoff: p99 and worst sample worsened but primary p95 improved and behavior remains generic for printable ASCII.

description: avoid final trim copy by stopping at the last non-space cell

asi.hypothesis: Build output lines only through the last non-space cell to avoid trim_end_matches plus to_string allocation.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 473us to 564us.
asi.next_action_hint: The rposition scan costs more than trimming in this workload; avoid extra row scans.

description: parse Flex markers without collecting split fields

asi.hypothesis: Avoid allocating a Vec for Flex marker fields during template tree parsing.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 473us to 485us.
asi.next_action_hint: Flex marker parsing is not the current p95 bottleneck, or the extra explicit checks offset the allocation removal.

description: skip Flex distribution when no child can grow or shrink

asi.hypothesis: Track grow and shrink eligibility while sizing children so layout skips no-op distribution scans.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 473us to 505us.
asi.next_action_hint: The extra flag bookkeeping costs more than the skipped no-op distribution scans.

description: accumulate natural Flex size without temporary vectors

asi.hypothesis: Natural size only needs sums and max values, so it can avoid collecting child sizes into a Vec.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 473us to 495us.
asi.next_action_hint: The iterator collect is not the limiting cost here; keep the clearer existing natural_size flow.

description: pass button actions by reference into text painting

asi.hypothesis: Avoid cloning the button action before text_canvas because hitbox cells already clone from the same source action.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 473us to 491us and worst latency spiked.
asi.next_action_hint: Action clone count is not a useful target for this small Action payload; focus on canvas and string work.

description: store untouched canvas cells as empty text

asi.hypothesis: After removing intermediate crop canvases, empty untouched cells avoid allocating and cloning space strings while final frame output still renders them as spaces.
asi.revisited: Earlier empty-cell attempt regressed before blit_from; the result improved after the canvas copy path changed.

description: skip trailing blank cells during frame output

asi.hypothesis: With untouched cells stored as empty text, output can skip trailing blank cells instead of pushing spaces then trimming.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 447us to 497us.
asi.next_action_hint: The extra reverse scan is not worth the reduced line build work.

description: truncate output lines in place after trimming spaces

asi.hypothesis: Avoid allocating a second String for trimmed output lines by truncating the built line in place.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us was 451us, slightly worse than current best 447us.
asi.next_action_hint: The extra allocation is not a stable p95 bottleneck after empty cells; try changes with larger structural savings.

description: preallocate frame output lines to row width

asi.hypothesis: Reserve each output line near the viewport width so final frame construction does fewer String reallocations.
asi.state_repair: Reconstructed from commit message because the worktree had .auto/log.jsonl deleted after compaction.

description: stream text lines directly while painting text canvases

asi.hypothesis: Avoid allocating a Vec of split text lines in text_canvas; iterate split lines directly while preserving text validation.

description: fold text validation into plain ASCII detection

asi.hypothesis: Validate each split line while detecting printable ASCII so text_canvas avoids a separate full-string validation pass.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed slightly from current best 402us to 404us.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep the simpler direct split-line streaming; avoid extra helper branches in the plain text hot path.

description: fast-path visible width for printable ASCII text

asi.hypothesis: Return byte length for visible_width when a text line is printable ASCII, avoiding char iteration and unicode-width lookup.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 402us to 452us; the extra ASCII scan or branch cost outweighed the saved width lookup.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not add separate ASCII detection in visible_width; gains are already captured better in text painting.

description: slice blit rows instead of checking each cell with get

asi.hypothesis: Slice target and source rows once in blit_from to avoid per-cell get/get_mut bounds checks.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 402us to 482us, with catastrophic max/worst outliers.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep the simple get-based blit; slice setup and range handling likely costs more or hurts optimizer behavior.

description: lock action arena once while parsing button markers

asi.hypothesis: Parse all Button action markers under one action arena lock instead of locking the mutex for every button.

description: preallocate Button marker strings

asi.hypothesis: Build Button markers with a preallocated String and write! instead of a format! call for every button.
asi.note: Uses only std::fmt::Write; no dependency or behavior change.

description: preallocate Flex and overflow marker strings

asi.hypothesis: Build Flex and OnOverflow markers with preallocated String buffers instead of format! calls.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from actual best 376us to 393us.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep Button marker preallocation only; Flex markers are fewer and manual assembly adds branch/code cost without p95 gain.

description: parse Button markers with split_once

asi.hypothesis: Use split_once for Button marker parsing to avoid a three-step split iterator and preserve malformed-marker checks.

description: preallocate action token strings

asi.hypothesis: Build action token strings with preallocated String and write! instead of format! in each action helper call.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from actual best 370us to 420us.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep format! for short action tokens; manual String assembly hurts p95 here.

description: stream leaf natural size calculation

asi.hypothesis: Compute leaf natural size by iterating split lines directly and remove the temporary Vec<&str> helper.
asi.note: This revisits the earlier natural-size allocation idea after text_canvas streaming changed the surrounding cost profile.

description: fold text validation into visible width scan

asi.hypothesis: Remove the separate validate_text scan in leaf natural_size by checking tabs and carriage returns inside visible_width.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from actual best 364us to 371us.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep validate_text separate; extra Result flow and per-character checks hurt p95 more than the removed scan helps.

description: preallocate parse stack and button label buffers

asi.hypothesis: Reserve small parse buffers for stack, root nodes, and button labels to reduce Vec/String growth during marker parsing.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary improved by only 1us versus actual best 364us, while p99/max/worst regressed and the fixed capacities risk overfitting the 100-button workload.
asi.next_action_hint: Avoid benchmark-shaped capacity constants unless repeated runs show a stable tail improvement or the capacity derives from input structure.

description: push focused Button marker as a char

asi.hypothesis: Avoid formatting the focused flag in Button markers by writing only the action id and pushing '0' or '1'.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from actual best 364us to 460us.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep the combined write! call for the Button marker header; splitting it into more push operations hurts p95.

description: feed action globals from iterator

asi.hypothesis: Avoid collecting action helper functions into a BTreeMap before passing them to MiniJinja Value::from_iter.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from actual best 364us to 375us.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep the explicit BTreeMap; MiniJinja conversion or iterator shape is not faster in this path.

description: control rerun of current best without code changes

asi.hypothesis: Measure current best again without code changes to estimate benchmark noise before accepting more tiny changes.
asi.rollback_reason: No code change to keep; measured p95 was worse than actual best 364us, showing high run-to-run noise.
asi.next_action_hint: Require larger p95 wins or repeat promising small wins before keeping benchmark-shaped changes.

description: compare printable ASCII bytes directly

asi.hypothesis: Replace Range::contains in the printable ASCII text_canvas check with direct byte comparisons.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from actual best 364us to 384us, and clippy flags the manual range check.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep the range contains form; the compiler and clippy prefer it.

description: control rerun current best with five benchmark runs

asi.hypothesis: Re-measure current best with RUNS=5 to reduce noise and calibrate future comparisons.
asi.rollback_reason: No code change to keep; p95 was 400us, far above the prior 364us best and close to the extension baseline.
asi.next_action_hint: Use RUNS=5 for larger changes but do not accept tiny wins without repeated confirmation.

description: accumulate initial flex main size while building sizes

asi.hypothesis: Avoid a separate sizes.iter().sum() scan by accumulating the total while building flex child main sizes.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from actual best 364us and RUNS=5 control 400us to 417us.
asi.next_action_hint: The iterator collect plus sum is better optimized or clearer; avoid manual loops for this scan.

description: write text cells through a borrowed row

asi.hypothesis: Borrow each text_canvas row once and write cells through that row instead of indexing canvas.cells[y] for every cell.
asi.comparison: Compared against the RUNS=5 current-best control because subsequent experiments use RUNS=5 to reduce noise.

description: hoist action option branch in ASCII text painting

asi.hypothesis: Split the printable ASCII text loop into Some(action) and None branches to avoid cloning Option<A> per cell.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from RUNS=5 best 379us to 473us.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep the single loop; branch duplication harms optimizer behavior or instruction cache more than Option clone costs.

description: control rerun of row-local text writes

asi.hypothesis: Re-measure current kept row-local text write change without code modifications to check stability.
asi.rollback_reason: No code change to keep; p95 was 471us with large max outliers, indicating environmental noise.
asi.next_action_hint: Look for changes with larger median and p95 wins; consider improving measurement isolation later.

description: skip synthetic root wrapper for single top-level Flex

asi.hypothesis: Avoid one layout wrapper when the rendered template has exactly one top-level Flex node, while preserving wrapper behavior for text, buttons, multiple roots, and top-level OnOverflow.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from RUNS=5 kept best 379us to 423us, despite lower p50.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not skip the root wrapper for p95; if revisited, add semantic tests for top-level justify, align, text, button, and multi-root behavior first.

description: parse Flex markers without collecting fields

asi.hypothesis: Parse Flex marker fields from the split iterator directly instead of collecting them into a Vec.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from RUNS=5 kept best 379us to 392us.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not revisit Flex field parsing unless profiling shows parse_flex_spec is hot under a less noisy benchmark.

description: store Canvas cells in one flat vector

asi.hypothesis: Replace Vec<Vec<Cell>> canvas storage with one flat Vec<Cell> to remove per-row allocations and improve locality.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from RUNS=5 kept best 379us to 523us, even though p50 improved slightly.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not flatten Canvas as a standalone change; row Vecs perform better for p95 and keep code simpler.

description: mutate default ASCII cells instead of replacing them

asi.hypothesis: For printable ASCII text, push the character into the existing default cell and set its action instead of constructing a new Cell.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from RUNS=5 kept best 379us to 439us.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep assigning a new Cell in the ASCII path; mutating existing cells is slower.

description: build canvas rows without cloning a prototype row

asi.hypothesis: Construct each Canvas row with resize_with(Cell::default) instead of cloning one prototype row for every row.
asi.comparison: Compared against the previous RUNS=5 kept best.

description: build canvas rows without cloning default cells

asi.hypothesis: Use resize_with for each Canvas row so creating blank canvases does not clone a default Cell with an empty String for every column.

description: skip duplicate text validation for Flex leaf children

asi.hypothesis: Flex already calls natural_size for every child, so leaf text inside Flex can reuse that validation and skip validate_text during text_canvas painting.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 361us to 369us, with worse p99/max/worst.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not split the text_canvas path just to skip validation; extra match/helper path costs more than the removed scan.

description: return static Flex choice strings

asi.hypothesis: Make parse_choice return the matching static choice string instead of allocating a String for Flex direction, justify, align, and overflow markers.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from RUNS=5 best 370us to 379us.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep the existing String-returning parse_choice; allocation removal here did not help p95.

description: direct paint plain ASCII Flex leaves

asi.hypothesis: Plain ASCII Text and Button leaves inside Flex can paint directly into the parent canvas and skip child Canvas allocation plus blit while preserving fallback behavior for ANSI, Unicode, and multiline text.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 361us to 393us despite avoiding many child canvases.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not use a branch-heavy direct paint path without carrying precomputed leaf flags; repeated ASCII scans and extra control flow outweigh allocation savings.

description: build each canvas row with vec macro

asi.hypothesis: Keep the one-row-at-a-time Canvas constructor but use vec![Cell::default(); width] inside each row instead of resize_with.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from RUNS=5 best 370us to 527us, with severe tail outliers.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep resize_with for Canvas rows; cloning Cells inside each row is worse.

description: move cells from local child canvases during blit

asi.hypothesis: Child canvases are local temporaries, so consuming them during blit can move non-empty cells into the parent instead of cloning String and action values.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 361us to 432us despite a better p50.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not consume child canvases in blit as a standalone change; mem::take and mutable source access improve median but hurt tail latency.

description: construct ASCII cell text with String::from char

asi.hypothesis: Use String::from(char::from(byte)) instead of char::from(byte).to_string() for one-cell printable ASCII text.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from RUNS=5 best 370us to 457us, with severe tail outliers.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep char::to_string for ASCII cell text; constructor substitution is not useful.

description: cache leaf text natural sizes in Node

asi.hypothesis: Store leaf natural sizes in Node with OnceCell so repeated Flex natural_size walks reuse prior text validation and width results.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 361us to 433us and worst latency spiked.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not put OnceCell inside every leaf Node; interior mutability and larger nodes cost more than repeated small text measurement in this workload.

description: store Flex child main and cross sizes in one Vec

asi.hypothesis: Replace separate naturals and main-size vectors in layout_flex_children with one small struct vector to reduce allocations and zips.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary render_p95_us regressed from current best 361us to 470us with severe worst-latency outlier.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep separate Vec<(width,height)> and Vec<usize>; the simpler primitive vectors optimize better than a local struct vector.
